Stockfish.js 19.0.1 / Stockfish 19 Lite single-threaded
License: GPL-3.0 (full text in stockfish-GPL-3.0.txt)
Authors: stockfish-AUTHORS.txt
Unmodified engine: /vendor/stockfish/stockfish-19-lite-single.js

Build instructions: /vendor/stockfish/README.md
Source URLs and file checksums: /vendor/stockfish/manifest.json

The engine is distributed locally. No game position, file, audio or user
information is sent to npm, unpkg, GitHub or an engine API at runtime.
